point.note: the scenario's base point, rounded to 0.01 degree

layout: each variable is values[i][j]: season ls[i] (degrees of solar longitude), local time local_time_h[j] (Martian hours; 24 is the end of the sol)

climatology.note: typical year: dust as observed, averaged over Mars years 24-35

cold.note: clear year: the least dusty of the observed years (less dust: more sunlight, wider day-night swing)

warm.note: dusty year: the dustiest observed years without a global storm

dust_storm.note: global dust storm: the MCD holds the dust at optical depth 5 and only models it from Ls 180 to 360
